game_desc: Count the fruit and tap the right number.
finishGame: You finished all the levels! Great job!
shapes_desc: Tap the figure with the right color and shape.
shapes_hint_look: Look carefully at the color and the shape.
feelings_desc: Look at the bunny and tap how it feels.
letters_desc: What letter does the fruit start with? Tap it.
adding_desc: Two groups of fruit. Tap how many there are together.
adding_hint_count: Count one group, then the other.
wash_desc: Tap the steps in the right order.
wash_how: Put the steps for washing your hands in order. Tap the right one first, then the next.
brush_desc: Tap the steps in the right order.
brush_hint_first: Start with water on the brush.
bath_desc: Tap the steps in the right order.
bath_how: Put the steps for taking a bath in order. Tap the right one first, then the next.
subtract_desc: Some fruit is gone. Tap how many are left.
subtract_hint: Count the pale fruit. Those are the ones left.
odd_desc: Four pictures. Tap the one that is different.
odd_hint: Three are the same. Find the other one.
more_desc: Two groups of fruit. Tap the one with more, or the one with fewer.
opp_desc: See one picture. Tap the opposite.
opp_hint: Think of the other one. Happy and sad, big and small.
read_desc: See the word. Tap the matching picture.
read_hint: Read the word, then find the picture.
order_desc: Three groups of fruit. Tap them from fewest to most.
order_hint: Count each group. Start with the one that has less.
miss_desc: A number is missing. Tap the one that fits.
pos_desc: A row of fruit. Tap the first one or the last one.
match_desc: See a number. Tap the pile with that many fruit.
match_hint: Count the fruit in each pile.
pat_desc: Colors in a row. Tap the color that comes next.
pat_hint: The colors repeat. Look back at the start.
sides_desc: See a shape. Tap how many sides it has.
shp_desc: Shapes in a row. Tap the shape that comes next.
shp_hint: The shapes repeat. Look back at the start.
same_desc: Two pictures. Tap if they match.
next_desc: Numbers in a row. Tap the number that comes next.
next_hint: Keep counting. What comes after the last number?
abc_desc: Letters in a row. Tap the letter that comes next.
abc_hint: Say the alphabet. What comes after the last letter?
bef_desc: See a letter. Tap the one before or after it.
bef_hint_before: Say the alphabet. What comes just before?
bef_hint_after: Say the alphabet. What comes just after?
rhyme_desc: See a word. Tap the word that rhymes.
rhyme_hint: Say both words out loud. Do they sound the same at the end?
syl_desc: See a word. Tap how many parts it has.
syl_hint: Say the word slowly. Clap once for each part.
sort_desc: Tap a shape, then tap its color group.
sort_prompt: Put each shape in its color.
sort_hint: Tap a shape first. Then tap the matching color.
shadow_desc: See a silhouette. Tap the matching picture.
shadow_hint: Look at the outline. Find the same shape.
time_desc: See a clock. Tap morning, day, night — or the hour.
time_prompt_part: Is it morning, day, or night?
time_hint_part: Look at the sky. Is the sun rising, high, or gone?
time_hint_hour: Look at the short hand. Which number does it point to?
season_desc: See a scene. Tap spring, summer, autumn, or winter.
season_hint: Look at the sky, leaves, and snow.
days_desc: Put the days in order. Later levels: drag missing days into place.
days_hint: Say the days in order. What comes after this one?
days_fill_prompt: Put each missing day in the right spot.
days_fill_hint: Drag a day onto the empty box that matches.
days_drag: Drag a day onto an empty spot.
days_drop: Drop it on the empty spot.
weather_desc: See a scene. Tap sunny, rainy, cloudy, or snowy.
weather_hint: Look at the sky. Is there sun, clouds, rain, or snow?
lr_desc: See an arrow or a side cue. Tap left or right.
lr_hint: Look which way the arrow points, or which side the fruit is on.
jigsaw_desc: Put the round puzzle pieces in the right places.
jigsaw_hint: Drag a piece onto the empty spot that matches. Or tap, then tap the spot.
jigsaw_tap_slot: Now tap its empty spot — or drag it there.
jigsaw_drag: Drag a piece onto the board.
jigsaw_drop: Drop it on the matching spot.
oless_desc: See a pile. Tap the number that is one smaller.
oless_hint: Take one away. What number is left?
omore_desc: See a pile. Tap the number that is one bigger.
omore_hint: Add one. What number do you get?
months_desc: Put the months in order. Later levels: drag missing months into place.
months_hint: Say the months in order. What comes after this one?
months_fill_prompt: Put each missing month in the right spot.
months_fill_hint: Drag a month onto the empty box that matches.
months_drag: Drag a month onto an empty spot.
months_drop: Drop it on the empty spot.
skip_desc: Count by 2s, 5s, or 10s. Tap the next number in the row.
skip_hint: Add {n} each time. What number comes after the last one?
